videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: The Cabin Masters work to finish Nine Mile Camp; after whitewater rafting, Chase and the team build bunk beds, Dixie and Jedi design an archery target, and Ashley continues her quest for a bug-free build; can they get it all done in two weeks?

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: Chase and his team take on a dated and dysfunctional cabin in Belgrade Lakes; with a budget of $40,000 and six weeks to finish the project, the team strives to turn this Long Pond cabin into the perfect family retreat.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: The Harringtons purchased a tranquil plot of oceanside property in Phippsburg way back in the 1950s; Joe Harrington, a Maine Basketball Hall of Famer, cleared a parcel so he can construct a camp of his own to add to the family's legacy.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: In Trenton, N.J., the team takes on an enormous high school, finding fireclay sinks and oak cabinets; Mike and Tay build an N-shaped desk in the shop.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: The team saves the bow and stern of a boat on Smith Mountain Lake in Moneta, Va.; the crew cuts up an old Chevy van for a commissioned piece of wall art.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: The crew members return to a high school in Trenton, N.J., where they find large clock faces and library ladders; Mike and Tay build a table from an old jail bed.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: The guys salvage the Reed Creek Mill in Wytheville, Va., where they find conveyor belts and a flour hopper; Mike builds a console for his nephew.

videos.title: Restoration Road With Clint Harp
videos.description: A century-old train car that served the timber industry in northern Idaho is rescued from a barn and brought back to life as a guest house on a pristine stretch of mountainous property.

videos.title: The Last Wright: Building the Final Home Design of America's Greatest Architect
videos.description: Sarah and Debbie take on the project of a lifetime, building a home from plans that were on Frank Lloyd Wright's drawing table when he died; but first, the town must approve their plans; they visit Fallingwater for inspiration.

videos.title: The Last Wright: Building the Final Home Design of America's Greatest Architect
videos.description: With challenges mounting up and no general contractor on board, Sarah and Debbie make a critical decision about who will lead the build; they visit Frank Lloyd Wright's last living original client for guidance on making adjustments to the plans.

videos.title: The Last Wright: Building the Final Home Design of America's Greatest Architect
videos.description: Sarah overcomes missteps as a first-time general contractor; with no second chance possible, their red concrete floor must turn out perfectly; modern building codes and materials force Sarah and Debbie to make updates to Frank Lloyd Wright's plans.

videos.title: The Last Wright: Building the Final Home Design of America's Greatest Architect
videos.description: More than 60 years after the original plans arrive, Sarah and Debbie race to finish Riverrock; a last-minute flood threatens to stop their progress; artisans, experts and friends come to see the space they created.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn
videos.description: The Cabin Masters tackle their biggest build ever at the former Rise and Shine BnB; massive rot behind the library fireplace threatens the timeline; Ashley races to save historic tiles.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn
videos.description: Chase and his team battle rot, ants and weather; Sarah and Ashley work with local artists to give the bathrooms a Maine aesthetic including custom tile, signature soap and a wooden bathtub.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn
videos.description: Sarah and Ashley collaborate with local artisans to craft a unique experience for guests; Chase battles porcupines in the barn.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn
videos.description: The dining rooms get a refresh, and the former caretaker's apartment is converted into a commercial kitchen. Later, Ashley and Sarah collaborate on custom doilies, while Dixie and Jedi give new life to chairs for the revamped dining rooms.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn
videos.description: With just a few months before guests arrive, Chase has a plan to build three new cabins to add more sleeping spaces. In the main building, the team creates a stylish new lobby, rehabbing a unique chess table and building a custom desk.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn
videos.description: The team must finish turning the horse barn into a venue space and outdoor spaces into guest-friendly patios, all while getting the kitchen ready for service.

videos.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: A couple with renovation know-how is looking for a fixer-upper lake house near Weiss Lake in Alabama, and find a place with hidden problems in the walls and under the floor.

videos.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: Two couples team up to buy their dream vacation house on Deep Creek Lake, Md.; their agreed upon must-haves include water views and space for nine people but finding a property that both couples agree on may be a challenge.

videos.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: A couple head back to their favorite spot from their college days to search for a vacation home near Deep Creek Lake, Md.; they're searching for a fixer-upper they can customize with easy lake access.

videos.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: A family finds the perfect lakefront location with a not-so-perfect house in Vermont. Their carpentry skills come in handy for the full gut renovation, as costly foundation repairs add up.

videos.description: After running a flipping business with his parents, a man and his fiancée are now looking for their first home along the lakes of the Delaware River Region of New Jersey. They plan to renovate the property themselves with help from his family.

videos.description: A young couple searches for a multifamily home on Minnesota's Lake Superior. They hope to live on one floor and also have income generating rentals. With the support of an investor and their own skills they hope to renovate for well under their budget.

videos.description: A military family known for frequently relocating is looking for a lakefront property to act as a constant to keep them grounded; their waterfront getaway will be a spot where the kids can grow up making memories out on the water.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: In New Hope, Va., the team saves parts of the Wilberger Funeral Home, including its elevator and barn-door hardware; Mike and the guys build a collapsible bookcase.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: In Mt. Vernon, Ohio, the team saves as much as it can from a house that has burned down; Mike builds a chair from a shopping cart.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: In Wellsville, Ohio, the crew takes on a Victorian house, salvaging harlequin windows, corbels and front porch columns; Mike and Tay use old brick molds to build a wine rack.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: The crew salvages an old diner sign in Roanoke, Va.; the team picks through a huge warehouse in Greensboro, N.C.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: Chase and his brother-in-law, Ryan, are inspired by a visit to the Allagash Brewing Company where their client works; they brew up some ideas to redesign the cabin while using items from the brewery as well as custom pieces to transform it.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: Chase and his team restore the old army barracks, which have provided overflow sleeping accommodations for more than 40 years at the Morrill family camp; the guys strive to save the structure for their growing family and future family reunions.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: In Oakland, Maine, Chase and his team take on a project on McGrath Pond that has been empty for 15 years; while it seems like a pretty straightforward renovation, starting a project this late in the season raises a lot of challenges.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: In Industry, Maine, Chase Morrill and his team of builders take on a cabin that hasn't been touched since the 1970s; they find out that 40 years of Maine winters have not been kind to this cabin, and issues begin to arise once the snow melts.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: In New Sharon, Maine, Chase and his team help Rod save his rundown camp from falling into the pristine Kimball Pond; he'd like to patch up the holes and get his wife to come back to the camp, which means it's going to need a lot of work.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: The guys tackle a cabin owned by one of their beloved subcontractors, Florida Nick; his family cabin is in need of some major upgrades; they are looking for more space on the first level and the guys build two cabin additions.

videos.title: Restoring Galveston
videos.description: Michael surprises Ashley with an 1893 raised cottage he purchased before seeing the interior; they find themselves in over their heads after realizing it's not quite the hidden gem Michael thought it was.

videos.title: Restoring Galveston
videos.description: Ashley and Michael jump at the chance to restore an 1866 Victorian designed by famed Galveston architect Nicholas Clayton. At 3,500 square feet, they face a massive undertaking to honor the home's historical integrity while staying within budget.

videos.title: Restoring Galveston
videos.description: The Cordrays turn an alley home once filled with cats into a getaway; this Galveston gem is highlighted with custom features including reclaimed wood walls and an upcycled stock tank bathtub.

videos.title: Restoring Galveston
videos.description: Michael and Ashley have their work cut out for them while restoring a dilapidated 1914 fixer-upper; they create a breakfast nook and re-purpose a vintage wooden sign to help transform what was once a condemned eyesore into a quaint pink corner house.

videos.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: A sibling house-flipping team searches for an affordable property in Gulf Breeze, Florida that they can renovate, enjoy for a few months each year, and then rent to vacationing families seeking a beach getaway.

videos.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: A father and son hope to leave the cold winters of Chicago behind by making a move to the Crystal Coast of North Carolina; with experience renovating homes, they don't mind putting in work as long as they're close to the beach for a great price.

videos.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: A business-savvy mom and daughter enlist the whole family to help create a fun Florida vacation rental as a moneymaking venture and a beach getaway for them all to enjoy.

videos.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
videos.description: A couple living in Seattle searches for a vacation getaway along the sands of Ocean Park, Wash, and waterfront homes in this Pacific coast community aren't cheap, so finding a deal could require some renovations.

videos.description: A married couple living in Washington, D.C., are looking for a weekend getaway in the nautical hotspot of Lusby, Md.; waterfront property is pricey, but they hope to find a deal.

videos.description: The crew salvages items from the chamber of commerce building in Roanoke, Va., including safe deposit boxes and a pneumatic messaging system; the team works on a large bar commissioned for the Natural Bridge Historic Hotel in Natural Bridge, Va.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: The team heads to the St. Michael's Catholic School in Pittsburgh, where they brave great heights in order to save elements from the past; the team also builds a ladder console and discovers a vintage army record player.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: The team preserves a Greek Revival farmhouse in Bentleyville, Pa., salvaging mantles, tiles and a full-sized chicken coop; Mike and Tay build a freight cart couch; Robert gets excited about a corn sheller.

videos.title: Salvage Dawgs
videos.description: The team heads to the Vaughan Furniture Company in Galax, Va.; Mike and Ted struggle to salvage a heavy furniture press, while Robert is slowed down by explosion-proof lights. Mike and Grayson build a chair with pieces from an old suitcase.

videos.title: Barnwood Builders
videos.description: The guys reclaim a 170-year-old corn crib filled with antique treasures, then they take the structure back to Lewisburg, W. Va., to be erected in an old-fashioned barn raising.

videos.title: Fixer Upper
videos.description: A couple searches for a contemporary home in Woodway, Texas.

videos.title: Fixer Upper
videos.description: The impending arrival of their baby determines the deadline for the renovation of a couple's ranch style house.

videos.title: Fixer Upper
videos.description: Chip and Joanna Gaines seek a home in Waco for Devon and Hannah Jonklaas; the Jonklaases want a home with lots of acreage and lots of bedrooms; Devon, a biochem professor, wants to be close to work and to Hannah, who's expecting.

videos.title: Fixer Upper
videos.description: A couple tours houses in Hubbard, Texas, looking for a four-bedroom, two-bath house with a large interior.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: A growing family needs more space at their camp on Pocasset Lake; while the crew handles the remodeling, layout revamp, wall replacement and dormer addition, Ashley and Ryan come up with a way to display the family's tradition of collecting rocks.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: When their business manager requests a brand-new build over a vacation-packed winter, the team loses track of the budget as time slips away and snow piles up; the crew try to finish the build without going any more over budget.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: A lake-loving family outgrows their legacy cabin; the gang tackles the challenges of remodeling the mazelike layout as Ashley uses an heirloom for a special project, all in time for the family's annual 4th of July party.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: Gardiner Area High School is in need of an outdoor classroom for their earth sciences program, so they call on some of their notable Gardiner Tiger alumni; the crew builds the room to be an optimal learning space with plenty of storage.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: The "Maine Cabin Masters" head to the hills to help the snow-happy Richardson family fulfill their dream of owning a slope side abode at the Black Mountain Ski Resort; the crew must overcome the difficulties of construction in a flood plain.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: After a tree falls onto the roof of a family camp, the mishap is chosen as an opportunity; the "Maine Cabin Masters" are called in to facilitate an expansion.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: A family wants to turn their worn and cozy fishing getaway into a modern vacation retreat; the Cabin Masters come to their aid with a massive expansion, raising the roof and combating big plumbing problems.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: A family in Ryan's hometown has a pair of cabins, right on the water, that are in need of updates after 40 years of use; the Cabin Masters provide a facelift, including updated foundations.

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: The Cabin Masters head to Winthrop, Maine to rescue a couple from their DIY project; with a new addition, deck, storage, and a mouse issue to fix, can the crew finish in time for the owners' 10th anniversary?

videos.title: Maine Cabin Masters
videos.description: Agassiz Village provides underprivileged and at-risk kids an opportunity to experience a camp surrounded by the beauty of Maine; with support from the community, Chase and his team take on the big project with a small budget to help the camp.
